_comment: Per-test bandit LOW ceilings. A single total was gameable: you could add
30 new try_except_pass and stay under the cap by deleting 30 subprocess
imports. Each test id now ratchets independently -- any of them may fall,
B110 (try_except_pass) is the one that matters most: 244 of its 250 sites
are an undocumented `except Exception: pass`, the exact fail-open shape
this repo keeps getting bitten by. It is capped here so it cannot grow
while the cleanup happens file by file.
